errors: A leading 0xFF alone does not establish that the file is UTF-16 LE; the opening assertion is too definite.
FF FE can also begin a UTF-32 LE BOM, so it does not by itself conclusively confirm UTF-16 LE.
An initial FF not followed by FE does not rule out UTF-16, which can exist without a BOM.
open() does not universally default to UTF-8; its default encoding depends on the Python version, locale, and UTF-8 mode.
